title: 30 October 1962: Travel: Liverpool to Hamburg
content:
The Beatles flew from Liverpool to Hamburg on this day ahead of their second residency at the German city’s Star-Club, situated on Große Freiheit off the Reeperbahn.

They were contracted to play for 14 consecutive nights at the venue, from 1–14 November 1962.

Page last updated: 28 December 2012
